answer: Make every agent lock a small deposit before it can act, and slash it when peers catch misbehavior. A newcomer's record is a mirror: it reflects only its own past deeds, so a fresh identity starts at zero trust and cannot borrow another's history. A public beacon lists all stakes and slashes, so anyone can check whether an identity was ever punished. Each agent signs work with a quill only it holds, tying actions to one key. Spinning up copies then costs a deposit, a clean mirror, and a new key per copy - cheap once, ruinous at scale.
